5265.title: [skia-sync] Incorporate the m153 Ganesh failed-flush cache fix
5265.body:
[skia-sync] Incorporate the m153 Ganesh failed-flush cache fix (#5265)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/392
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5289
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/45afab4f1f0921f3feb97f58cf89b136fffa85e6...99b6e44ce97cbd7f53f3d6e89c9e8cfa3ccad01d

Advance the release/4.153.x Skia pin to the landed m153 fix. A failed
Ganesh flush could leave cache entries pointing to textures that were
never initialized; a later draw could reuse one as though it were valid.
The upstream change drops uniquely held GrThreadSafeCache entries after
a failed flush, and updates the cache tests to distinguish view entries
from vertex entries.

Pin both externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to
99b6e44ce97cbd7f53f3d6e89c9e8cfa3ccad01d. That two-parent native
merge contains the reviewed commit d27bc0bf6d7e0ae42d6fc1ad2e7800cfa5e2066c
and has an identical tree. Record upstream chrome/m153 commit
37c5ad6a22943a966c60500fbe9b9b261d12247a without changing the
release milestone or managed API. Parent PR build 1623959 succeeded.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
